sourceTitle: More Than Three Quarters of Small Business Owners Say AI Makes Them More Productive, But Most Need More Guidance
originalTitle: More Than Three Quarters of Small Business Owners Say AI Makes Them More Productive, But Most Need More Guidance
author: ginamurphy

blocks.text: Today, we’re releasing findings from a new YouGov study we commissioned of almost 4,000 small business owners across nine APAC markets: Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Japan and Hong Kong, on how AI is helping them grow, compete with larger businesses and reach customers beyond their borders.
blocks.zh: 今天,我们...我们委托近4000个小企业主在9个APAC市场进行一项新的YouGov研究,澳大利亚新加坡越南印度尼西亚,台湾印度泰国日本和香港,美国关于AI是如何帮助他们成长的,与较大的企业竞争,并接触其境外的客户。
blocks.en: Today, we’re releasing findings from a new YouGov study we commissioned of almost 4,000 small business owners across nine APAC markets: Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Japan and Hong Kong, on how AI is helping them grow, compete with larger businesses and reach customers beyond their borders.

blocks.text: AI adoption is already broad, with 84% of surveyed small business owners currently using AI, 76% reporting a positive impact on productivity and 71% reporting a positive impact on revenue or sales over the past 12 months. Small business owners also report AI helps tackle two significant challenges facing small businesses: limited resources and limited time.
blocks.zh: 大赦国际的收养范围已经很广,84%的接受调查的小企业主目前使用人工智能,76%报告对生产力产生了积极影响,71%报告在过去12个月对收入或销售产生了积极影响。小企业主还报告说,大赦国际帮助解决小企业面临的两个重大挑战:资源有限,时间有限。
blocks.en: AI adoption is already broad, with 84% of surveyed small business owners currently using AI, 76% reporting a positive impact on productivity and 71% reporting a positive impact on revenue or sales over the past 12 months. Small business owners also report AI helps tackle two significant challenges facing small businesses: limited resources and limited time.

blocks.text: Owners say AI is helping small businesses compete. Across the nine markets, four in five (80%) owners agree AI helps small businesses compete more effectively with larger companies, and the same proportion say it makes starting a business easier. 83% agree AI enables small businesses to do things that previously required significantly more money or resources.
blocks.zh: 业主称AI正在帮助小企业竞争.在9个市场,五分之四(80%)的业主同意AI帮助小企业更有效地与大公司竞争,同样的比例 说它使得创业更容易。83%的人同意大赦国际允许小企业从事以前需要大量金钱或资源的工作。
blocks.en: Owners say AI is helping small businesses compete. Across the nine markets, four in five (80%) owners agree AI helps small businesses compete more effectively with larger companies, and the same proportion say it makes starting a business easier. 83% agree AI enables small businesses to do things that previously required significantly more money or resources.

blocks.text: And, they say the time saved is going back into the business. Among those reporting a positive productivity impact from using AI, 58% are using the time to improve the quality of their existing work, 50% are putting it into growth and business planning, and 46% are getting more done with the team they already have.
blocks.zh: 还有,他们说,节省下来的时间是 回到生意。在报告使用大赦国际对生产力产生积极影响的人中,58%正在利用时间提高现有工作的质量;50%正在将其投入到增长和商业规划中,而46%的球队 已经完成了更多的任务。
blocks.en: And, they say the time saved is going back into the business. Among those reporting a positive productivity impact from using AI, 58% are using the time to improve the quality of their existing work, 50% are putting it into growth and business planning, and 46% are getting more done with the team they already have.

blocks.text: The everyday uses are practical. Among surveyed owners whose business has used AI in the past 12 months, 51% have used it to create or edit content, 43% for local advertising and marketing, 38% for translation, and 37% for customer support and communications.
blocks.zh: 日常的用途是实用的.在过去12个月中,在企业使用人工智能的受调查业主中,51%的人用它来创建或编辑内容,43%用于当地广告和营销,38%用于翻译,37%用于客户支持和通信。
blocks.en: The everyday uses are practical. Among surveyed owners whose business has used AI in the past 12 months, 51% have used it to create or edit content, 43% for local advertising and marketing, 38% for translation, and 37% for customer support and communications.

blocks.text: AI is delivering for SMBs, 76% owners reporting a positive impact on productivity
blocks.zh: AI正在为SMB送货,76%的业主报告对生产力产生了积极影响
blocks.en: AI is delivering for SMBs, 76% owners reporting a positive impact on productivity

blocks.text: More than four in five owners surveyed (86%) say small businesses need more guidance to gain the full benefits of AI. Cost is the leading barrier to training, cited by 51%. When asked what support they would value most, owners pointed to clearer information on cost and return on investment, and guidance on data privacy and security.
blocks.zh: 接受调查的5个业主中有4个以上(86%)说小企业需要更多的指导才能获得AI的全部利益.成本是培训的主要障碍,引用率为51%。当被问到他们最需要什么支持时,所有者指出,关于成本和投资回报的信息更加明确,以及关于数据隐私和安全的指导。
blocks.en: More than four in five owners surveyed (86%) say small businesses need more guidance to gain the full benefits of AI. Cost is the leading barrier to training, cited by 51%. When asked what support they would value most, owners pointed to clearer information on cost and return on investment, and guidance on data privacy and security.

blocks.text: In other words, small businesses have adopted AI – what they’re asking for now is help using it well. To make the most of AI, they need free training, clearer information on costs and returns, and policies that support access and investment in AI and digital skills.
blocks.zh: 也就是说,现在他们要求的是帮助善用人工智能。为了充分利用AI,他们需要免费训练,更清楚地说明成本和回报,以及支持获取和投资于人工智能和数字技能的政策。
blocks.en: In other words, small businesses have adopted AI – what they’re asking for now is help using it well. To make the most of AI, they need free training, clearer information on costs and returns, and policies that support access and investment in AI and digital skills.

blocks.text: Helping Small Businesses Get More From AI
blocks.zh: 帮助小企业从大赦国际获得更多
blocks.en: Helping Small Businesses Get More From AI

blocks.text: That’s why we’ve been partnering with governments and industry associations to help businesses use AI effectively, so more entrepreneurs can compete and contribute to economic growth. This research follows the launch of the Meta Small Business Growth Academy across Asia-Pacific earlier this year – a programme built to help small businesses move from small to scale using digital and AI-enabled tools to find customers, improve productivity and grow across borders. Delivered with governments, chambers of commerce and local programme partners, it offers practical training in AI-enabled advertising, Reels, WhatsApp for Business and cross-border commerce.
blocks.zh: 所以我们一直与政府和行业协会合作,帮助企业有效利用AI,因此,更多的企业家可以竞争,为经济增长作出贡献。这项研究是今年早些时候在亚太地区启动的 " 梅塔小企业增长学院 " 之后进行的,该学院是为帮助小企业从小企业发展到小企业。利用数字和人工智能工具寻找客户,提高生产力和跨界增长。与各国政府合作,商会和地方方案伙伴,它提供人工智能广告方面的实用培训,里尔斯,商务与跨境商务的WhatsApp.
blocks.en: That’s why we’ve been partnering with governments and industry associations to help businesses use AI effectively, so more entrepreneurs can compete and contribute to economic growth. This research follows the launch of the Meta Small Business Growth Academy across Asia-Pacific earlier this year – a programme built to help small businesses move from small to scale using digital and AI-enabled tools to find customers, improve productivity and grow across borders. Delivered with governments, chambers of commerce and local programme partners, it offers practical training in AI-enabled advertising, Reels, WhatsApp for Business and cross-border commerce.

blocks.text: Small businesses can get started with AI-enabled tools from Meta today, including Advantage+ to create and run high-performing ads, ads that click to WhatsApp to turn conversations into customers, and Meta Business Agent to handle customer enquiries automatically.
blocks.zh: 小企业可以从今天的Meta开始使用人工智能工具,包括优势+创建和运行高性能广告,点击WhatsApp将对话变成客户的广告,和Meta Business Agent自动处理客户查询.
blocks.en: Small businesses can get started with AI-enabled tools from Meta today, including Advantage+ to create and run high-performing ads, ads that click to WhatsApp to turn conversations into customers, and Meta Business Agent to handle customer enquiries automatically.

blocks.text: In Indonesia, Husnul Khotimah, founder of modest fashion brand Zayya, used Small Business Growth Academy training to expand into Malaysia on a daily ad budget of just Rp30,000 [approx USD 1.68]. Using business tools from Meta, she generated 50 enquiries, while reducing customer response times from 30 to 60 minutes to under two minutes. This helped to increase sales – she reported more than eight times return on ad spend for this campaign.
blocks.zh: 在印度尼西亚,胡斯努尔·霍蒂玛创建了谦虚的时尚品牌Zayya,利用小企业增长学院的培训向马来西亚扩展,每天的广告预算只有30,000卢比[约合1.68美元]。使用Meta公司的业务工具,她产生了50个询问,将顾客的反应时间从30分钟减少到60分钟,到不到2分钟。这帮助增加了销售量 — — 她报告了八倍多的广告支出回报,用于这一运动.
blocks.en: In Indonesia, Husnul Khotimah, founder of modest fashion brand Zayya, used Small Business Growth Academy training to expand into Malaysia on a daily ad budget of just Rp30,000 [approx USD 1.68]. Using business tools from Meta, she generated 50 enquiries, while reducing customer response times from 30 to 60 minutes to under two minutes. This helped to increase sales – she reported more than eight times return on ad spend for this campaign.

blocks.text: Ms Khotimah says, “Meta has helped me see what is possible for a small business like Zayya. I used to think AI was mainly for writing captions and creating content, but I’ve learned that it can also help me understand new markets and reach the right customers. Using tools like Advantage+, we’ve been able to reach customers beyond Indonesia with a small advertising budget, while giving me more time to grow the business and connect with more women who share the same needs that inspired Zayya in the first place.”
blocks.zh: 霍蒂玛女士说:“Meta帮助我看到了像Zayya这样的小生意是可行的。我曾经认为AI主要用于写字幕和创建内容,也帮助我了解新市场,使用“优势+”等工具,在印度尼西亚以外的地区, 我们用少量的广告预算,同时给我更多的时间来发展这个企业,并与更多的妇女建立联系,这些妇女有着相同的需要,这些需要从一开始就激发了扎伊亚的灵感。”
blocks.en: Ms Khotimah says, “Meta has helped me see what is possible for a small business like Zayya. I used to think AI was mainly for writing captions and creating content, but I’ve learned that it can also help me understand new markets and reach the right customers. Using tools like Advantage+, we’ve been able to reach customers beyond Indonesia with a small advertising budget, while giving me more time to grow the business and connect with more women who share the same needs that inspired Zayya in the first place.”

blocks.zh: 印度尼西亚时装品牌扎伊亚

blocks.text: At Meta, we believe the future is for everyone, and that includes small businesses. We’ll keep working with governments, partners and entrepreneurs across APAC so more small businesses have the skills, tools and confidence to grow with AI.
blocks.zh: 在梅塔我们相信未来是每个人的,包括小企业。我们将继续与政府合作,整个APAC的合作伙伴和企业家,因此更多的小企业拥有技能,与大赦国际一起成长的工具和信心。
blocks.en: At Meta, we believe the future is for everyone, and that includes small businesses. We’ll keep working with governments, partners and entrepreneurs across APAC so more small businesses have the skills, tools and confidence to grow with AI.

blocks.text: The research was commissioned by Meta and conducted online by YouGov among 3,983 small business owners across Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Japan and Hong Kong. Data was collected between 6 August and 2 September 2026.
blocks.zh: 该研究由Meta委托YouGov在澳大利亚全国3 983个小企业主中在线进行,新加坡越南印度尼西亚,台湾印度泰国日本与香港.数据采集于2026年8月6日至9月2日期间.
blocks.en: The research was commissioned by Meta and conducted online by YouGov among 3,983 small business owners across Australia, Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Taiwan, India, Thailand, Japan and Hong Kong. Data was collected between 6 August and 2 September 2026.

blocks.text: Within each market, quotas were applied by business size to achieve a broad and balanced spread across businesses with 1–9, 10–19 and 20–49 employees. The findings provide insights across a diverse cross-section of small businesses in each market, rather than being nationally representative of the small business population. Reported adoption and impact differ across the nine markets surveyed. These differences may partly reflect how owners in each market interpret the questions, as well as translation and local survey response norms.
blocks.zh: 在每个市场,配额按企业规模加以应用,以在企业之间实现广泛和均衡的分布,为1至9个。10–19和20–49名员工.调查结果为每个市场的各类小企业提供了深入的见解,而不是代表全国的小企业人口。在所调查的9个市场中,报告的采用和影响各不相同。这些差异可能部分反映了每个市场的所有者如何解释这些问题,以及翻译和地方调查答复规范。
blocks.en: Within each market, quotas were applied by business size to achieve a broad and balanced spread across businesses with 1–9, 10–19 and 20–49 employees. The findings provide insights across a diverse cross-section of small businesses in each market, rather than being nationally representative of the small business population. Reported adoption and impact differ across the nine markets surveyed. These differences may partly reflect how owners in each market interpret the questions, as well as translation and local survey response norms.
